messages:
Ava: Quick pass pls — drafting the post for next Tuesday (product-day). Pulled together a teaser grid + micro-bench claims. need eyes on copy + routing for webinar signups. link: https://drive.redwood/apply/teaser-grid-v3 :eyes:
Lukas: thanks — skimmed. overall tone good. two asks: 1) tighten the benchmark language so it doesn't sound like a head-to-head claim, 2) can we surface the latency/price bullets earlier?
Ava: good call on bullets. current hero line: "Redwood Optimize: cut inference cost, keep quality." thinking to change to: "Cut inference cost up to 3x while preserving quality for production apps." does that risk sounding too competitive?
Sam (Legal): flag — avoid absolute "3x" unless we tie to a specific benchmark & config. If you want to keep it, append parenthetical like "(on our internal micro-bench for Llama-2 13B, quantized)" or switch to "up to 3x in certain workloads."
Priya: from demand-gen — we need a clear webinar CTA and the routing tags for HubSpot. Can we add default utm params and a lead source field? Example UTM: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=product_day_optimize
Nina: also request: the webinar signup should map leads to the "Optimize Launch" campaign in HubSpot and set a custom property "interest_area: optimize" so SDRs can filter.
Ava: thanks. Drafting a quick CSV map for ops:
route_field, hubspot_field, example
source, original_source, blog
utm_campaign, campaign, product_day_optimize
custom_interest, interest_area, optimize
Can someone confirm this is fine to hand to growth-ops?
Lukas: CSV looks fine. Add "lead_owner: marketing-nda" default so we don't create unassigned leads.
Sam (Legal): also tweak micro-bench copy: replace "preserving quality" with "while maintaining output fidelity on our eval suites" — less vague. Also drop the word "guarantee."
Priya: I'll build the HubSpot form with those fields. timeline? need final copy by EOD Friday to set up flows and automation.
Ava: EOD Friday works. Edits I will do now: change hero modifier per Sam, add latency & price bullets under intro, add UTM example snippet. Will ping for final signoff.
DeployBot: Note: marketing-forms/optimize-launch created (ID: fm_87321). Preview: https://forms.redwood/optimize-launch/preview
Nina: preview looks good, small nit: webinar date in the form header still says "TBD" — can we lock to Tuesday 10am PT once event is confirmed?
Priya: will set to Tuesday 10am PT once marketing confirms. I can set form to draft until then.
Ava: great. final blockers?
Lukas: none from product once legal wording updated.
Sam (Legal): approved after language change. please include the parenthetical benchmark note in the post copy.
Ava: perfect — will push updated draft shortly. thanks everyone :rocket:
